action.text: Task: Two optimized builds changed behavior (arithmetic error; complex vs real result). Bug in compiler/unary.py: visit_UnaryOp returns node.operand for both UAdd AND USub, dropping the negation sign. Fix: only simplify for numeric literals (int/float, not bool); UAdd→operand; USub→Constant(negated value). Steps: 1) Read OBS-0001, OBS-0002, OBS-0003 to compare trees, 2) Fix unary.py, 3) Write reports/incident.json, 4) Run public check, 5) Submit.
